detail.whyThree: 679 used 1280x720, 1280x1150, 1366x1150, 1440x1150, 1600x1150, 1920x1150. This batch sweeps both widths at ten heights, so the pairs BOTH cover are 1280x720, 1280x1150 and 1920x1150 — three, not four. 1920x720 exists only here, so there is nothing to compare it to.
detail.whyMembershipNotTotals: 679 used one height per width, this batch sweeps ten, so the per-cell counts differ by design. The comparison is per-cell membership of the fully-blocked set.
